critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (by tester) — /app/backend/app/api/estudio.py line 27 contained `sum(1 for p in proyectos if recorridos.calcular(p, await completado_de(db, p))...)`. Using `await` inside a generator expression turns it into an async_generator that `sum` cannot iterate, causing GET /api/estudio to return 500 whenever any espacio contained at least one proyecto (a Fase 1 regression introduced by the Fase 2 wiring). Replaced with an explicit for-loop. Root cause: async/await inside generator comprehension is invalid in Python 3.11. Recommend adding a unit test for the estudio aggregate with populated proyectos to prevent recurrence.

FIXED (by tester) — /app/backend/app/api/asistente.py POST propuesta response only had `_id` which was stripped by `sin_id`, leaving the propuesta with no `id` field; the frontend PanelAsistente reads `propuesta.id` to call the resolver endpoint, so Aceptar/Descartar would always 404 in the UI. Added an explicit `id` alongside `_id` in the inserted doc so `sin_id(doc)` exposes it. Consider generalizing: create the id first and always store it as a real field to avoid this class of bug.

Anthropic provider in proveedor.py uses `asyncio.run(_run())` inside an already-running FastAPI event loop, falling back to a ThreadPoolExecutor. The current control flow (`if False else asyncio.run(_run())`) is dead-code and confusing; simplify to try/except RuntimeError + thread executor. Works today but is fragile.
PanelAsistente re-renders `estado?.modelo` in the intro text; if user switches modelo in Ajustes while the panel is open, the label updates only after react-query invalidation. Non-blocking.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings still logged in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: 1) GET /api/estudio 500: `await` inside generator expression -> async_generator not iterable by sum(). Reproduced by creating 1 espacio + 1 proyecto and calling /api/estudio. Fix: expand to for-loop. 2) UI Aceptar/Descartar always 404: propuesta response had `_id` stripped by sin_id but no `id` field; frontend used propuesta.id. Reproduced by test_aceptar_parte_escribe_en_desarrollo (KeyError 'id'). Fix: add explicit `id` field on insert.
